paper_title: Automatic Task Detection and Heterogeneous LLM Speculative Decoding
caption: The word "reaction" tends to co-occur with different tokens in the domains of chemistry (a) and mathematics (b).

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The provided image displays two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), each illustrating the distribution of tokens that co-occur with the word "reaction" within distinct domains. Chart (a) represents the chemistry domain and is divided into seven segments, each corresponding to a specific token as indicated by the legend: "the" (light blue with diagonal stripes, 31%), "this" (light blue with horizontal stripes, 21%), "for" (green with crosshatch, 17%), "chemical" (green with grid, 15%), "to" (yellow with grid, 9%), "in" (light blue with vertical stripes, 7%), and an unlabeled segment (light blue with diagonal stripes, 15%). Chart (b) represents the mathematics domain and is divided into four segments, corresponding to tokens in the legend: "the" (light blue with diagonal stripes, 38%), "$" (pink with dots, 27%), "equilibrium" (yellow with grid, 19%), and "constat" (gray with dots, 15%). Both charts include legends that map each patterned color to its respective token label, and each segment is labeled with its corresponding percentage value. The segments in both charts are arranged in a clockwise order from the top, with the largest segment positioned at the top right. There are no visual cues such as expanded or emphasized segments to indicate any particular importance.
model_annotations.English: The image displays two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), illustrating the co-occurrence frequencies of different tokens with the word "reaction" in two distinct domains: chemistry (chart a) and mathematics (chart b). Chart (a) is divided into six segments, each with a unique pattern and percentage: a dark blue hatched segment labeled “the” at 31%, a light blue hatched segment labeled “this” at 21%, a green cross-hatched segment labeled “for” at 17%, a green grid-patterned segment labeled “chemical” at 15%, a yellow textured segment labeled “to” at 9%, and a light blue striped segment labeled “in” at 7%. Chart (b) is divided into four segments, each with a unique color and percentage: a dark blue hatched segment labeled “the” at 38%, a pink dotted segment labeled “$” at 27%, a yellow textured segment labeled “equilibrium” at 19%, and a gray dotted segment labeled “constatant” at 15%. Both charts include legends mapping the patterns/colors to their respective token labels, and each slice is clearly labeled with its corresponding percentage value inside the segment. The segments in both charts are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest slice at the top right and proceeding clockwise.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt zwei Kreisdiagramme, die die Verteilung von Tokens, die mit dem Wort „reaction“ in den Domänen Chemie (a) und Mathematik (b) co-occur, darstellen. Diagramm (a) besteht aus sechs Segmenten, die jeweils mit einer Farbe und einem Muster sowie einem Prozentwert gekennzeichnet sind: „the“ (blau mit diagonalen Linien, 31%), „this“ (blau mit horizontalen Linien, 21%), „for“ (grün mit quadratischem Muster, 17%), „chemical“ (grün mit diagonalen Linien, 15%), „to“ (gelb mit diagonalen Linien, 9%) und „in“ (blau mit feinen vertikalen Linien, 7%). Diagramm (b) besteht aus vier Segmenten: „the“ (blau mit diagonalen Linien, 38%), „$“ (rosa mit punktiertem Muster, 27%), „equilibrium“ (gelb mit diagonalen Linien, 19%) und „constatant“ (grau mit punktiertem Muster, 15%). Beide Diagramme enthalten Legenden, die die Tokens zu den entsprechenden Farben und Mustern verbinden, und die Prozentwerte sind direkt innerhalb der Segmente angegeben. Die Segmente sind in beiden Diagrammen nach absteigender Größe angeordnet, wobei das größte Segment jeweils im oberen rechten Bereich beginnt.
